lint.rule_1: Remove “{text}”: it is a tag the model reads aloud.
lint.rule_10: Missing “{sign}”: questions take ¿ at the start and ? at the end; exclamations take ¡ and !.
lint.rule_11: The sentence has {count} words and the maximum is {max}: split it.
lint.rule_19: “{text}” distorts the voice: use an impersonal construction, like “it is recorded”.
lint.rule_2: “{text}” is in capitals for emphasis, which changes nothing: use lowercase.
lint.rule_3: The sentence does not end with a period, a question mark or an exclamation mark.
lint.rule_6: “{text}” does not belong here: use a period. A colon only goes before a list.
